text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 236 million markka median forecast for forestry group Metsa-Serla Oy's January-August profit after financial items, before extraordinaries.
The results are due on October 17 at 0830/0530 GMT.
In January-August 1995, Metsa-Serla posted a 1.29 billion markka profit.

For Metsa-Serla's full-year 1996 profit, nine of the 12 analysts polled gave a median forecast profit after financial items, before extraordinaries of 233 million markka (mean 261 million) in a 70-591 million markka range.
Metsa-Serla said on September 24 it expected a loss in May-December but the full-year 1996 result would still be in the black. Its 1995 profit after financial items was 1.91 billion markka.
The data were collected in the first two weeks of October.
Contributors to the survey were AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, Alfred Berg, Carnegie, Enskilda, Evli Securities, FSB Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Merita and Opstock.
